mapper.select: select f.fno, f.ftitle, f.fcategory, f.fcontent, f.ftitle_en, f.ftitle_ja, f.ftitle_zh, f.fcontent_en, f.fcontent_ja, f.fcontent_zh, a.admno from tbl_faq f inner join tbl_admin a on f.admno = a.admno where f.fno = #{fno} and f.fdelete = false

select count(f.fno) from tbl_faq f where f.fdelete = false
and f.fcategory = #{fcategory}
